summary: In the dojo, Morpheus presses his attack on Neo, countering his blows while landing several stinging slaps, and urges him verbally to move faster — to stop thinking and simply know. When Neo still hesitates, Morpheus cracks him again; Neo's face twists with rage as the pace of the blows accelerates. Morpheus shouts at him to stop trying and just hit him. Immediately afterward, a single blow from Neo catches Morpheus on the side of the head, knocking off his glasses.

what_changes.before: Held back and hesitant, unable to land a real blow despite Morpheus pushing him
what_changes.after: Rage unlocks his speed; he lands a clean, single strike that knocks Morpheus's glasses off
what_changes.evidence: Neo's face twists with rage as the speed of the blows rises like a drum solo.

what_changes.before: Dominating the exchange, countering blows and slapping Neo at will
what_changes.after: Struck on the side of the head by Neo, his glasses knocked off
